parts.text: I plan and run flights as a dispatcher, taking legal responsibility for deciding which drone flies and along which way before signing off a flight. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. Before and during a flight, things happen outside my control like whether the load is ready or how the drone reaches its points, while closure zones and sudden closures announced by authorities might come into force while my drones are already in the air.
